title: Impeccable 4.1 release — critique, native review, live mode fixes
summary: Paul Bakaus announces Impeccable 4.1 with 43 PRs: chat critique reliability, calmer design hooks, native iOS/Android reviews, Windows install fixes, and live mode on ddev/valet hosts.
question_it_answers: What changed in Impeccable 4.1 for critique, native apps, and live-mode dev hosts?

claims.text: Critique results print in chat before follow-up questions more reliably.
claims.evidence: critique results more reliably prints in chat before asking you questions
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: Live mode now works on ddev, valet, and other non-localhost dev hosts.
claims.evidence: works on ddev, valet, and other non-localhost dev hosts
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: Install or upgrade via npx impeccable install at impeccable.style.
